'''Drinda-Zel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] who served [[Darth Malgus]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. She was killed during the [[Battle of Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" />
